source_caption:
27 Dresses is a charming romantic comedy about love, self-discovery, and learning to stop living for everyone else. Starring Katherine Heigl as Jane Nichols, the film follows a woman who has spent years being the perfect bridesmaid for her friends, collecting 27 bridesmaid dresses along the way, while quietly putting her own dreams and happiness aside.

Everything changes when Jane is forced to confront her feelings as her younger sister becomes engaged to the man she’s secretly loved for years. At the same time, she forms an unexpected connection with a cynical wedding reporter played by James Marsden.

What makes 27 Dresses so enduring is its relatable heroine. Beneath the weddings, humor, and romance is a story about finding your voice and realizing that constantly putting others first can come at the expense of your own happiness. Katherine Heigl brings warmth and vulnerability to Jane, making her easy to root for from beginning to end.

Funny, heartfelt, and full of romantic-comedy charm, 27 Dresses is ultimately a reminder that sometimes the person you’ve been waiting for is yourself, and that happiness begins when you stop settling for the role of supporting character in your own life.

source_details.synopsis: 27 Dresses is a 2008 American romantic comedy film directed by Anne Fletcher and written by Aline Brosh McKenna. It stars Katherine Heigl, with James Marsden, Edward Burns, Malin Akerman, and Judy Greer in supporting roles. Produced by Spyglass Entertainment and distributed by 20th Century Fox, the film was conceived following the success of McKenna's screenplay for The Devil Wears Prada (2006). Principal photography took place in New York City and Rhode Island from May to July 2007.
